title: Google\Cloud\Dlp\V2\CloudStorageRegexFileSet
name: CloudStorageRegexFileSet
description: Message representing a set of files in a Cloud Storage bucket. Regular expressions are used to allow fine-grained control over which files in the bucket to include.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.bucket_name
params.description: The name of a Cloud Storage bucket. Required.

params.name: data.include_regex
params.description: A list of regular expressions matching file paths to include. All files in the bucket that match at least one of these regular expressions will be included in the set of files, except for those that also match an item in exclude_regex. Leaving this field empty will match all files by default (this is equivalent to including .* in the list). Regular expressions use RE2 syntax; a guide can be found under the google/re2 repository on GitHub.

params.name: data.exclude_regex
params.description: A list of regular expressions matching file paths to exclude. All files in the bucket that match at least one of these regular expressions will be excluded from the scan. Regular expressions use RE2 syntax; a guide can be found under the google/re2 repository on GitHub.
